errors.text_span: 图表由多个彩色切片构成，每个切片代表一个具体的语义类别，并标注了其在总样本中的百分比。
errors.evidence: The figure contains two pie charts, not a single pie chart; the description misrepresents the structure.

errors.text_span: 最大的切片为“物态事态”，占比23.4%，颜色为浅粉色；紧随其后的是“生活工作”，占比23.3%，颜色为浅蓝色；“其他”类别占比19.38%，颜色为浅灰色；“生产”占比16.91%，颜色为绿色；“身体动作”占比9.9%，颜色为深蓝色；“心理活动”占比10.64%，颜色为深紫色；“争斗”占比9.57%，颜色为深红色；“帮助”占比4.26%，颜色为橙色；“表情”占比5.32%，颜色为浅橙色；“方位改变”占比18.09%，颜色为橙红色；“际遇”占比5.32%，颜色为深棕色；“交通”占比4.26%，颜色为浅蓝色；“判断”占比8.51%，颜色为浅灰色；“司法”占比10.64%，颜色为深灰色；“文教”占比5.57%，颜色为深蓝色；“战争”占比8.87%，颜色为深红色；“生理活动”占比9.48%，颜色为深蓝色。
errors.evidence: Several category-color mappings are wrong. For example, '物态事态' is the pinkish slice, but '帮助' is orange and '表情' is salmon; '际遇' is a brownish slice, not deep brown vs. '司法' is dark teal/blue, not deep gray; '交通' is light teal, not light blue; '判断' is light blue-green, not light gray. Also the machine description assigns categories from both pie charts into one list without distinguishing the two charts.

errors.text_span: 最大的切片为“物态事态”，占比23.4%
errors.evidence: The right pie's largest slice is '物态事态' at 23.4%, but the description incorrectly implies it is the overall largest slice of the single chart rather than one of two separate pies; this is tied to the structural error and conflates the charts. Also it omits that the left pie's largest slice is '生活工作' at 23.3%.

errors.text_span: 旨在通过多语体语料库与依存分析揭示汉语中与男性相关的动词在语义上的分布特征。
errors.evidence: This is interpretive purpose beyond the visible chart content; the figure only shows category distributions and does not state this explanatory claim.

errors.text_span: 整体来看，切片按大小顺序排列，呈现出不同语义范畴在男性动词使用中的相对频率。
errors.evidence: The slices are not ordered by size; the pie slices appear arranged arbitrarily. The statement adds interpretive ordering not shown in the figure.
